ns2:course.label: Audio Production
ns2:course.description: Project-based study of professional techniques in audio recording, mixing, and editing for music, theatre, and film production, utilizing current digital technology. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: THEA 453.
